21.
All  members,  officers  and  servants  of  the
Commission shall be deemed to be public servants within
the meaning and for the purposes of the Penal Code and of
the Code of Criminal Procedure Act, No.15 of 1979.

22.
The Commission shall be deemed to be a Scheduled
Institution within the meaning of the Bribery Act, and the
provisions of that Act shall be construed accordingly.
